allow: PowerShell(for \($i=1; $i -le 3; $i++\) { "run $i"; dotnet test tests/OB2.Integration.Tests -c Release --no-build -nologo 2>&1 | Select-String -Pattern "Passed!|Failed!|\\[FAIL\\]|Error Message" -Context 0,2 | ForEach-Object { $_.ToString\(\).Trim\(\) } | Select-Object -First 12 })

PowerShell($env:OB2_RUN_LARGE = "1"; dotnet test tests/OB2.Integration.Tests -c Release --no-build -nologo --filter "FullyQualifiedName~AC1_one_gigabyte|FullyQualifiedName~Benchmark_throughput" --logger "console;verbosity=detailed" 2>&1 | Select-String -Pattern "AC-1|MiB/s|Passed|Failed|Error Message" | ForEach-Object { $_.Line.Trim\(\) } | Select-Object -First 30; Remove-Item Env:OB2_RUN_LARGE)
